requirement: After the live sync landed on develop, its two site doors are in the API reference, the config test knows localStand, no fleet script reads a pipe with head under pipefail, and every sync translation keeps the terms file, site and backup

oracle.invariant: S1: 'every route the app serves is in the reference, and every documented route is served' is ok: GET and POST /api/sites/:key/sync are documented. S1: 'the seat removal is documented as naming its action' is ok: the bodyOptional rows are exactly POST /api/sites/:key/sync and DELETE /api/sites/:key/seats/:grant. S1: 'empty means off: no mail key is the console transport, no session domain is host-only' is ok: the config keys include localStand, true on a plain-http localhost origin outside production. S1: 'no shell file under pipefail reads a pipe with a reader that quits early' is ok: provision.sh and webroot-sync.sh read the Joomla dbprefix with sed -n 1p. S1: 'every shipped catalogue keeps every listed term' is ok: the de/it/fr/nl/zh/es tracy-my-sites.sync.* strings keep file, site and backup.
